entities.name: Building Project
entities.description: Construction and renovation of educational facilities, including new pre-kindergarten buildings and site plan modifications at St. Philip's School, including setbacks, building replacements, and multipurpose spaces, as discussed in the City Commission Meeting on January 9, 2024.

entities.name: Parking Issues
entities.description: Concerns related to parking availability, setbacks, and garage removals on properties, particularly in relation to the new building project at St. Philip's School, as referenced in city planning and site development discussions.

entities.name: Community Harmony
entities.description: Efforts and discussions aimed at maintaining positive relationships among residents, school community members, and city officials, especially in the context of school expansion and neighborhood development projects.
